stories.title: Follow live: Commanders fighting from behind after Jayden Daniels goes down
Commanders QB Daniels suffers elbow injury against Cowboys
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels was carted off the field in Sunday's game against the Cowboys after suffering an injured left elbow on the final play of the first half.

stories.title: Bears QB Williams leaves on cart after injuring hamstring
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings with a right hamstring injury.

stories.title: WR London regrets argument with fan, but 'I don't take light to disrespect'
stories.summary: Falcons wide receiver Drake London got into a verbal confrontation with someone in the crowd during his team's 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.

stories.title: Ole Miss up to No. 4, LSU slides to 10th as 10 SEC teams ranked
stories.summary: Ole Miss moved into the top five with its win over LSU, the Tigers stayed in the top 10, and Florida and Mississippi State cracked the rankings to give the SEC 10 teams in The Associated Press Top 25.
